requirements.text: The outer shell has overall dimensions of 150 mm x 120 mm x 80 mm.
The unit includes an outer shell that houses the drawer.
The shell contains exactly two internal side rails, one on each inner side wall.
The unit includes a drawer that is a separate body from the shell and fits inside the shell.
The drawer rests on and slides along the two internal side rails.
There is 0.5 mm clearance on each side between the drawer and the adjacent rails/shell side walls.
The drawer has a pull handle.
The pull handle is mounted on the front face of the drawer, on the side that faces out of the shell opening.
The shell has an open front allowing the drawer to be inserted and withdrawn.
The drawer body fits within the shell's internal dimensions without interfering with shell walls or rails.
